text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and I head to the<n>racecourse for a
photoshoot in her<n>signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Great work on the shoot today!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Likewise. I appreciate your hard<n>work.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
It's nothin', really! I mean, gettin' to<n>photograph
the Emperor herself? It's<n>an honor!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Here're the samples from the shoot.<n>They came
out lookin' pretty nice, if I<n>do say so myself!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When an Umamusume first dons her<n>signature
racewear, it's customary to<n>send a photograph to
close relatives.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There are few greater honors than<n>being able to
wear our finery on the<n>world's largest stage, so
it's only<n>right to share that joy with those<n>close to
us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With that said, I'm debating whether<n>or not I should
send a picture to my<n>parents.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's... complicated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, I haven't told<n>you much
about my family, have I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My parents are... passionate and<n>uncompromising,
shall we say. They<n>work themselves to the bone in
order<n>to make the world a better place.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Being their offspring, I am naturally<n>expected to
follow in their footsteps.<n>They have always held me
to their<n>own strict standards.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To be clear, I don't resent them for it.<n>I love them
both dearly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My parents gave me a strict<n>upbringing because
they believe I'm<n>capable of great things, and for
that, I<n>am grateful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Their parenting inspired me to seek<n>my purpose on
the track, which is<n>what led me to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But, as you know, I still have a long<n>way to go. I'm
a far cry from the<n>leader they hope I can become.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So, as I said, it's complicated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They may not be pleased to see me<n>proudly
dressed in finery when I have<n>yet to accomplish
anything of note.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Or that's my concern, at any rate. I'm<n>sorry, it must
be a surprise to see me<n>at such a loss.
choice_data_list: Why not present it as a progress report?
I kinda want to see you get told off.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hah. It's all a matter of framing, isn't<n>it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Very well. I may do just that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If they are dissatisfied with my<n>progress, so be it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, Symboli Rudolf<n>informs me that
she has received a<n>reply from her parents.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As expected, they didn't mince<n>words... but there
was a small<n>expression of gratitude tacked onto<n>the
end of the letter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To think that even this trifling praise<n>leaves me
struggling to conceal my<n>happiness... I really do
have a long<n>way to go.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In any case, thank you for giving me<n>the push I
needed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It might just be my imagination, but a<n>weight seems
to have lifted from<n>Symboli Rudolf's shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. You say the oddest things<n>sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, you may well get your wish.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I think I will send them the photograph<n>after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If worst comes to worst, their<n>disappointment will
sting less if<n>you're there to share it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, Symboli Rudolf<n>informs me that
she has received a<n>reply from her parents.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As expected, they didn't mince<n>words... but there
was a small<n>expression of gratitude tacked onto<n>the
end of the letter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Dear me. And I had so hoped to treat<n>you to a
mollified expression.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yet here I find myself smiling instead.<n>So it goes.
choice_data_list: I'll take that as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. I just can't get the better of<n>you, can I?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It might just be my imagination, but a<n>weight seems
to have lifted from<n>Symboli Rudolf's shoulders.
